description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Minimum Rates of Wages for the Match, Hosiery, etc. Manufacturing Trades
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters - specifically, notifications under the Wages Boards Ordinance that establish minimum wage rates for specific trades (Match Manufacturing and Hosiery Manufacturing). It involves regulatory decisions approved by the Minister, sets legally binding wage standards, and amends previous regulations through statutory instruments. While it mentions a government official (the Minister), it does not focus on government personnel changes or structural reorganization, but rather on establishing legal wage requirements for private sector trades.
